verses.en: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
verses.pt: O Senhor te ouça no dia da angústia; o nome do Deus de Jacó te proteja.
verses.en_web: May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> May the Lord give ear to you in the day of trouble; may you be placed on high by the name of the God of Jacob;

verses.en: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.pt: Envie-te socorro do seu santuário, e te sustenha de Sião.
verses.en_web: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
verses.en_bbe: May he send you help from the holy place, and give you strength from Zion;

verses.en: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.pt: Lembre-se de todas as tuas ofertas, e aceite os teus holocaustos.
verses.en_web: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: May he keep all your offerings in mind, and be pleased with the fat of your burned offerings; (Selah.)

verses.en: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.pt: Conceda-te conforme o desejo do teu coração, e cumpra todo o teu desígnio.
verses.en_web: May He grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
verses.en_bbe: May he give you your heart's desire, and put all your purposes into effect.

verses.en: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.pt: Nós nos alegraremos pela tua salvação, e em nome do nosso Deus arvoraremos pendões; satisfaça o Senhor todas as tuas petições.
verses.en_web: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.
verses.en_bbe: We will be glad in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will put up our flags: may the Lord give you all your requests.

verses.en: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.pt: Agora sei que o Senhor salva o seu ungido; ele lhe responderá lá do seu santo céu, com a força salvadora da sua destra.
verses.en_web: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.en_bbe: Now am I certain that the Lord gives salvation to his king; he will give him an answer from his holy heaven with the strength of salvation in his right hand.

verses.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
verses.pt: Uns confiam em carros e outros em cavalos, mas nós faremos menção do nome do Senhor nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust the name of Yahweh our God.
verses.en_bbe: Some put their faith in carriages and some in horses; but we will be strong in the name of the Lord our God.

verses.en: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.pt: Uns encurvam-se e caem, mas nós nos erguemos e ficamos de pé.
verses.en_web: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
verses.en_bbe: They are bent down and made low; but we have been lifted up.

verses.en: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
verses.pt: Salva-nos, Senhor; ouça-nos o Rei quando clamarmos.
verses.en_web: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!
verses.en_bbe: Come to our help, Lord: let the king give ear to our cry.
